description: He wears an opaque navy wool knee-length tunic over a cream linen shirt, with tan geometric woven borders around the slit neckline, cuffs and hem. A narrow brown leather belt has a plain metal buckle and a long end. A coarse brown wool cloak drapes over both shoulders and closes at one shoulder with a round metal brooch. Loose brown wool trousers end in layered brown leg wraps above dark brown leather ankle shoes. No headgear or weapon is visible.
